description: This file defines the CustomerOptionDescription entity class, which extends Description, representing a description of a customer option with additional attributes like comments. It is part of the data model for the customer options in the sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing a description of a customer option, with references to CustomerOption and comment text.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionComment
methods.description: Returns the comment string for the customer option.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionComment
methods.description: Sets the comment string for the customer option.
